# everpure_azure_volume_group_connection_parameters (Data Source)

Looks up the iSCSI connection parameters (portal IPs, ports and target IQN) of an existing Volume Group.

To connect an Azure virtual machine to one or more Volume Groups automatically, instead of reading these parameters and configuring the connection yourself, use the [`everpure_azure_virtual_machine_connection` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/resources/azure_virtual_machine_connection).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

# Looks up a Volume Group, created outside this Terraform configuration, and its
# iSCSI connection parameters.
data "everpure_azure_storage_pool" "example" {
  name                = "pool-prod-east"
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

data "everpure_azure_volume_group" "example" {
  name            = "vg-prod-east"
  storage_pool_id = data.everpure_azure_storage_pool.example.id
}

data "everpure_azure_volume_group_connection_parameters" "example" {
  volume_group_id = data.everpure_azure_volume_group.example.id
}

# Sorted by portal IP and port; every endpoint of one Volume Group shares its IQN:
#
# iscsi_endpoints = tolist([
#   {
#     "ip" = "10.0.1.4"
#     "iqn" = "iqn.2010-06.com.purestorage:flasharray.1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b"
#     "port" = 3260
#   },
#   {
#     "ip" = "10.0.1.5"
#     "iqn" = "iqn.2010-06.com.purestorage:flasharray.1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b"
#     "port" = 3260
#   },
# ])
output "iscsi_endpoints" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_volume_group_connection_parameters.example.iscsi_endpoints
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `volume_group_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Volume Group. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `iscsi_endpoints` (Attributes List) The Volume Group's iSCSI endpoints, sorted by portal IP and port. Empty when the Volume Group currently has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iscsi_endpoints))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the volume group's connection parameters.


<a id="nestedatt--iscsi_endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `iscsi_endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Portal IP address of the endpoint.
- `iqn` (String) IQN of the endpoint. Every endpoint of one Volume Group shares the same IQN.
- `port` (Number) Portal port of the endpoint.
